results.q: What are the requirements to be a Circles User?
results.a:
Fully understand that this is a research program and the app is not intended for public use  

Agree to fulfill the commitment as research participants and participate in a series of activities from the beginning until the end of the research program  

Understand and agree to all terms stated in the Informed Consent 

Have a smartphone with an active internet 

Have a working email address 

Have a Facebook account or agree to have a Facebook account created for them 

Understand the value of sharing and is eager to work hand in hand with their community

results.q: How is it possible that Circles Points are free?
results.a: Circles is a non-profit project that aims to support an innovative UBI digital point delivery system. The project is sponsored by philanthropic visionaries that are committed to seeing how such a system may be of most benefit to communities. Once the project model is fully developed that project will integrate self-sustainability solutions to allow the project to keep developing without the need to burden the end users with any fees.

results.q: What can Circles users do with the App?
results.a: Circles users can gift Circles to people they care about or exchange items or services for Circles points with other Circles users.

results.q: What are the benefits you get as a Circles user?
results.a:
The Circles App is free 

Receive Circles Points, for free, every day! (your UBI) 

Use Circles Points for goods or services 

Circles Points can help your family meet daily needs 

You can donate or send Circles Points as a gift 

Circles Points deduces your need to carry & use cash 

Support positive social impact in your community 

Circles is very easy to use once you know how 

Save money by using Circles Points instead of cash

results.q: How do I register as a Circles user?
results.a: If you are part of the research 2023 program, you will be guided to the sign up process during Circles onboarding workshops. At this point, only selected research participants can join to use the application

results.q: Does it cost anything to use Circles?
results.a: The Circles app is free and does not charge for anything.

results.q: Can Circles help me save money?
results.a: Circles can help users to save or even allocate their cash for investment by using Circles Points as an additional resource to exchange for goods/services. Circles Points for each user will increase by 24 Circles every day.

results.q: Can Circles strengthen my community's local economy?
results.a: Yes, Circles can help strengthen the local economy because Circles encourages the exchange of locally available goods/services for the fulfillment of daily needs.

results.q: Does Circles pose any risks for its users?
results.a: There are no harm or risks from using Circles app, but please make sure to read the Informed Consent if you have any concerns.
